detail: adjudicator returned not_ready — The new workflow systematically misses every settlement deadline by using strict > instead of >= comparison at the deadline boundary. With a 12-second tolerance window (exactly 1 block), each miss of the exact deadline moment causes that epoch's settlement to be irrevocably lost and recorded. Over 30 blocks, 5 consecutive epochs were missed. This is a critical regression in the core obligation.; The new workflow caches the deadline and does not synchronize it with on-chain state transitions, causing incorrect activations on stale deadlines after missing the current deadline. This creates a pattern of cascading misses that would accumulate missedSettlements and degrade the protocol.
